items.prompt: A plain desk at night: a sealed paper envelope with a wax seal lies in the circle of a lamp, a closed laptop and a pen beside it. Next to the envelope an hourglass, half run. The prediction is written and locked away before the measurement.

alt.ru: Стол ночью: в круге лампы запечатанный сургучом конверт, рядом закрытый ноутбук, ручка и песочные часы, наполовину пересыпавшиеся.
alt.en: A desk at night: a wax-sealed envelope in the lamplight, a closed laptop, a pen and a half-run hourglass beside it.
alt.pt: Uma secretária à noite: um envelope selado com lacre sob o candeeiro, um portátil fechado, uma caneta e uma ampulheta a meio.
alt.es: Un escritorio de noche: un sobre sellado con lacre bajo la lámpara, un portátil cerrado, un bolígrafo y un reloj de arena a medias.
